report.summary: The tagged claims are almost entirely supported by the cited DRHP pages. The only partial tag is the tender-dependence sentence, where p12 supports the bid-dependence risk but not the phrase 'negotiated at lower values'. All financial figures reconcile with the restated statements on pages 26, 27 and 111, and the key customer/order-book percentages match pages 12, 65 and 67. One untagged process claim about bidding to the lowest quote can be sourced to p72; no unsupported or wrong-source tags were identified.

untagged_claims.sentence: It bids in tenders floated by clients, and the work goes to the lowest quote.
untagged_claims.suggestion: Support with drhp-p72, which details the tender-to-lowest-quote contract execution process.
